finding: Slovak turnover expectations diverge from rising euro area optimism
bullets: Slovak firms' turnover expectations fell to a net 6.75% (n=228), down 14.15 pp from two waves earlier, against the euro area's net 25.88% (n=5,266) — a gap of 19 pp.
Slovak fixed investment expectations rose to a net 14.67% (n=228), up 3.88 pp from two waves earlier, outpacing the euro area's net 9.45%, which itself declined 3.13 pp.
Euro area and German turnover expectations both improved from two waves earlier, to net 25.88% and 19.08% respectively, underscoring Slovakia's divergent trajectory.
chart_subtitle: Slovak turnover outlook fell to net 6.75% in wave 38.
